annotations.title: Log a note, call, meeting or task

description: Log a note, call, meeting or task on a person or company record the customer's CRM holds. The record must be one returned by find_person_in_crm, search_crm or add_person_to_crm.

content.description: the text of the note, or what the call, meeting or task is about

due_date.description: for a task, call or meeting: the date, as YYYY-MM-DD

due_time.description: the time of day, as HH:MM in 24 hours

duration_minutes.description: for a call or meeting: how long it lasts, in minutes

entity_type.description: contact or lead, for CRMs that keep both

record_id.description: the id of the person or company record, as returned by find_person_in_crm, search_crm or add_person_to_crm

name: log_crm_activity
title: Log a note, call, meeting or task
